rule: Protect copy, navigation and orientation during transformation with local, semantically timed measures.
why: A signature loses product value when the visitor cannot read or act.
mechanism: Content hierarchy stays legible while the environment expresses change.
whenToUse: Changing geometry/light behind text or coupled captions and scene states.
whenNotToUse: Do not freeze the entire environment or obscure meaning to preserve one text block.
parameters: Contrast, safe zone, caption windows, content priority and hierarchy by viewport.
dependencies: Essential content inventory and representative viewports.
implementationPattern: Give essential text a stable content layer.
Coordinate reading windows with the visible semantic state.
Use local shading/dimming or composition changes; preserve moving geometry where safe.
Design mobile hierarchy and reduced/static meaning separately.

goodExample.claim: LAMELLA used local emission dimming behind the active text; Human readability passed.

antiExample.claim: VELORUM refinement still reported short-landscape overlap and document/field catch-up mismatch.

tests: Read at endpoints, peak, worst boundary, pause and rapid traversal.
Inspect compact/short landscape, keyboard focus and reduced/static path.
repairStrategy: Change local contrast protection, composition or reading windows.
Preserve stable orientation cues; synchronize copy/world deliberately.
Do not alter product truth to fit the effect.
cost: Local layout/shading complexity; avoid per-frame layout churn.

provenance.claim: Candidate operationalization of existing human/technical experiment evidence; transfer unvalidated.
HEG/TEG specification and Human Authority boundary.

transferability: Observed context only; weaker-model and cross-domain transfer TO VALIDATE.
